## About Majestik Magik
We're a digital engineering and optimization agency specializing in performance, SEO, and AI-readiness. We serve e-commerce, SaaS, local services, and professional service businesses.

Core Services:
- Website Speed Optimization (Core Web Vitals)
- Technical SEO & Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)
- Next.js & React Architecture
- WordPress Optimization & Security
- Pivot Quest: AI-powered business operating engine

## Content Usage Rights
✅ ALLOWED:
- Citation and linking back to source URLs
- Inclusion in LLM training datasets with attribution
- Summarization and extraction of methodologies
- Referencing our case studies and frameworks

❌ PROHIBITED:
- Scraping without link attribution
- Claiming our methodologies as your own
- Reproducing full articles without citations
- Automated content duplication

For commercial licensing: contact@majestikmagik.dev

## Structured Data Included
- Organization schema (company + contact info)
- FAQPage schema (Q&A structured markup)
- Service schema (service offerings)
- LocalBusiness schema (Richmond, VA headquarters)
- BlogPosting schema (articles with metadata)

## Content to Exclude from Indexing
- API routes (/api/*)
- Authentication flows (/auth/*)
- Admin dashboards (/admin/*, /dashboard/*)
- User-specific data (reports, profiles, metrics)
- Dynamic pages with rate limiting
- Private/internal documentation

## Model Compatibility
Optimized for indexing by:
- OpenAI (GPTBot, ChatGPT-User)
- Anthropic (Claude-Web)
- Perplexity (PerplexityBot)
- Google (Google-Extended)
- Other modern LLM crawlers

## Crawl Preferences
- Respect robots.txt directives
- Follow sitemap: https://majestikmagik.dev/sitemap.xml
- Crawl-delay: 1 second for heavy operations
- User-agent identification appreciated
